chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ismail ibn Marrar, from Yunus, from Umar ibn Abi Hafs, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'Fear Allah, and upon you is the performance of the trust to the one who entrusted you, and even if the murderer of Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) had entrusted me with a trust, I would have returned it to him.'

key_terms.ائْتَمَنَكُمْ: Entrusted you (verb form indicating the act of giving a trust)
key_terms.الْأَمَانَةِ: The trust or deposit given to someone for safekeeping
key_terms.قَاتِلُ عَلِيٍّ: The murderer of Ali ibn Abi Talib, used here as a specific example of an enemy or distinct individual

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on returning a trust to the person who gave it, even if they are your enemy?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes the fulfillment of amanah as an absolute duty independent of the trustee's merit, using the specific example of Hasan ibn Muhsin (the killer of Imam Ali) to demonstrate that even an enemy or slayer retains the right to their trust. This narration underscores the Shia principle of justice and fidelity in transactions, ensuring that the sanctity of the trust is not compromised by the character or status of the recipient.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ismail Bin Marrar, from Yunus, from Umar Bin Abu Hafs who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Fear Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! And upon you is with the repaying of the entrustments to the one who entrusted you, and even if the murderer of Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Abu Talib<sup>asws</sup> had entrusted me upon an entrustment, I<sup>asws</sup> would have repaid it to him<sup>la</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ‘Isma’il ibn Marrar from Yunus from ‘Umar ibn abu Hafs who has said the following:

“I heard abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘You must maintain piety before Allah and you must return a trust to the one who has entrusted you with it. Even if the assassin of Ali ibn abu Talib entrusted me with something, I had to return it to him safely.’”
